text:
maria: ping — acme-corp on private VPC says their console shows zero traffic/metrics since their OIDC swap at ~03:00 UTC. API calls succeed (200) but the dashboard usage graphs are blank. customer can repro with their calls.

devon: can you paste a minimal repro curl + the ingress logs where the request arrives? also any recent config changes on their private overlay?

maria: repro curl they ran (redacted):

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted_jwt>" \
  https://private.acme.example.redwood/v1/generate
```

maria: customer says when they hit the endpoint the response is normal, but our console shows "no series" for their tenant. they attached an ingress access log line with headers — note: X-Tenant header is missing in the logged request.

maria: ingress log snippet (redacted):
```
"GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1" 200 345 - "-" "curl/7.68.0" x-forwarded-for: 10.0.0.5
headers: Authorization: Bearer <ok>, Host: private.acme..., x-tenant: <MISSING>
```

telemetry-bot: alert: telemetry.pipeline.warning - 1200 events missing tenant header for overlay=acme-private (since 03:05 UTC)

akshay: quick theory — acme rotated their OIDC provider and the claim we map to X-Tenant changed name. our edge middleware reads jwt claim `tenant_id` to set x-tenant header; if their new tokens use `org_id` we won't emit the header -> telemetry pipeline drops tenant dimension.

devon: can we confirm token claims? maria, do they have a sample JWT (redacted) so we can jq the payload?

maria: they provided a redacted payload. payload contains: {"sub":"...","email":"ops@acme","org_id":"acme-corp","iat":...}

akshay: yep that's the drift. we need a short-term mapping: set x-tenant = jwt.claims.tenant_id || jwt.claims.org_id. Envoy JWT filter supports header mapping from claims. propose patch to their ingress filter to add a fallback expression.

akshay: suggested envoy snippet (concept):
```
- name: envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn
  config:
    providers: { ... }
    rules:
      - match: { prefix: "/" }
        requires: { provider_name: local }
        add_authentication: true
    post_authn: # pseudocode for header mapping
      request_headers_to_add:
        - header: x-tenant
          value: "%JWT{.payload.tenant_id | .payload.org_id}%"
```

devon: if we can't do expression in that filter, we can add a small lua/envoy header transform that does: if x-tenant empty -> set from org_id claim. Need configmap patch. I'll prepare canary.

maria: customer willing to accept short maintenance. please note this is private overlay so we run their overlay patch.

devon: running: kubectl -n acme apply -f acme-ingress-patch.yaml (canary) — patch sets header from org_id fallback. rolling out to 10% of pods.

telemetry-bot: deploy.event - rollout started for acme-ingress (canary 10%) by devon

maria: customer confirms new requests now show x-tenant header in ingress logs. sample log:
```
headers: Authorization: Bearer <ok>, Host: private..., x-tenant: acme-corp
```

telemetry-bot: telemetry.pipeline.info - tenant header present for new events; metrics ingestion resumed for overlay=acme-private

maria: customer reports console graphs begin to populate after ~7 minutes. they verified usage numbers match API calls. :tada:

jules: add to postmortem: create monitoring for jwt-claim drift + runbook to check header mapping after provider rotations. also add test in private-deploy playbook to validate tenant header forwarding after OIDC rotations.

devon: will follow up with a permanent config change to make the mapping robust and add integration test. closing incident after runbook updated.

maria: closing loop with customer and asked them to reach out if anything else. resolved. :white_check_mark:
